ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Adplus.EXE Abuse
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "AdPlus.exe", a binary that is part of the Windows SDK that can be used as a LOLBIN in order to dump process memory and execute arbitrary commands.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\adplus\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "Adplus\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-hang\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-pn\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-pmn\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-p\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-po\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-sc\\ .*")))
